Home.title: Pharmaceutical sourcing, connected across borders.
Home.description: Connecting international buyers with licensed pharmaceutical manufacturers in Bangladesh.
Home.heroNote: For wholesale buyers, patients and caregivers. Every requirement receives a private, tailored quotation.
Home.heroCardTitle: A direct connection. A considered approach.
Home.heroCardBody: Your medicine requirements, connected with licensed manufacturers and a dedicated sourcing team.

Home.manufacturersDescription: Our sourcing model connects buyers directly to licensed Bangladeshi manufacturers. Product availability and documentation are verified for each enquiry.

Home.temperatureBody: Identify cold-chain requirements at the start so handling needs can be reviewed for your route.
Home.documentationBody: Destination requirements and manufacturer documentation are reviewed with your enquiry.

Services.title: Cold-chain & sourcing services
Services.description: Direct manufacturer sourcing, destination-specific documentation and considered handling for international wholesale buyers, patients and caregivers.
Services.sourcingBody: Share the medicine, quantity, packaging unit and destination you need. Our team reviews sourcing through licensed Bangladeshi manufacturers and coordinates documentation before confirming your private quotation.
Services.destinationNote: Import requirements, transport options and temperature-sensitive handling are reviewed for each enquiry. Dispatch follows the route and lead time agreed in the accepted quotation.

Metadata.title: MedAxis Global Pharma | Pharmaceutical Sourcing

Shell.directSourcing: Direct sourcing from licensed Bangladeshi manufacturers
Shell.headerNote: For institutions, wholesale buyers, patients & caregivers
Shell.sourcingStatement: Bangladesh-based pharmaceutical sourcing, exclusively from licensed manufacturers, for international wholesale buyers and individual patients.
Shell.disclaimer: Product information is provided for sourcing enquiries and does not replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional. Related medicines are not recommendations for substitution.
Shell.prescriptionDisclaimer: Prescription uploads are optional. Supply and import arrangements remain subject to applicable destination requirements and professional review.

Cart.title: Your RFQ list
Cart.emptyHelp: Add a catalog product or describe a medicine you need.
Cart.prepare: Tell us what you need. Add this requirement to your list before discussing a private quotation with our team.
Cart.savedLocally: Your list is saved on this device. No enquiry has been sent yet.
Cart.privateQuote: Availability, lead times and commercial terms are confirmed privately by our sourcing team.

Contact.title: Contact MedAxis
Contact.intro: Discuss your medicine requirements with our sourcing team through an official contact channel.
Contact.unavailable: Contact details for this channel will be available soon.
Contact.qrAlt: Official MedAxis WeChat contact QR code
Contact.scanWechat: Open WeChat and scan this QR code to contact our team.
Contact.chinaEmail: For Mainland China, email is the primary channel for secure quotation links. WeChat supports direct conversation with our team.

Rfq.intro: Request a private quotation. Prescription attachments are optional for every buyer.
Rfq.contactHelp: Provide at least one contact channel: email, WhatsApp or WeChat.
Rfq.emailRequired: Email is required for Chinese-language enquiries or a China destination.
Rfq.unitHelp: Use the packaging unit you need (for example BOX). Our team’s configured units are validated when you submit.
Rfq.unitInvalid: This packaging unit was not accepted. Check the unit or contact our team.
Rfq.challengeUnavailable: Secure verification is not configured. Please use an official contact channel below.
Rfq.challengeNeeded: Complete the security challenge before uploading or submitting.
Rfq.fileHelp: Up to five JPEG, PNG or PDF files, each no larger than 5 MB (5,242,880 bytes). You can submit without an attachment.
Rfq.fiveFiles: You can attach up to five files. Remove a file before choosing another.
Rfq.uploadCancelled: Upload cancelled. This file is not attached.
Rfq.fileSize: Choose a non-empty file no larger than 5 MB.
Rfq.fileType: Choose an actual JPEG, PNG or PDF whose content matches its file type.
Rfq.uploadUncertain: The upload could not be confirmed. Remove this file and choose it again to retry, or submit without it.
Rfq.retention: Prescriptions are kept for at most 90 days from upload, or 14 days after a terminal enquiry/order state, whichever is earlier.
Rfq.successHelp: Keep this RFQ reference. Our sourcing team will use the contact details you provided. Notification delivery may follow separately.
Rfq.emailGuidance: Secure quotation links are sent by email. For China, use email for the link and official WeChat / WhatsApp for direct conversation; WeChat notifications are not automatic.
Rfq.validationHelp: Some details were not accepted. Check the highlighted fields before submitting again.
Rfq.challengeRecovery: Verification was not accepted. Complete the refreshed challenge and retry this same enquiry. Your inputs have been kept.
Rfq.rateLimited: Too many requests. This enquiry has not been confirmed. Check the same attempt again after waiting; do not send a separate enquiry.
Rfq.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your enquiry outcome is unconfirmed; check the same attempt again.
Rfq.uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Your enquiry may have been received. Check this same attempt to recover its reference.
Rfq.conflictRecovery: This attempt cannot yet be reconciled. Keep the attempt ID and contact our team. Do not create a separate enquiry until the existing one is resolved.
Rfq.lockedHelp: Your submitted details are held unchanged until the outcome is resolved. Keep this page open to avoid losing the attempt ID.

Quotation.title: Quotation
Quotation.privacy: Private access · Keep this link confidential
Quotation.reservationHelp: The deadline shown is set by MedAxis. Reopening this page does not extend the reservation. Contact our team about bank payment and fulfilment.
Quotation.unavailableHelp: Unavailable or sourcing lines do not carry a payable amount here. Use the confirmed server totals below.
Quotation.bankHelp: These bank details accompany this authorized quotation. Confirm any requested change directly with our official team before transferring funds.
Quotation.bankUnavailable: Bank details are not available in this document. Contact our official team before arranging a transfer.
Quotation.acceptTerms: I have reviewed and agree to this quotation’s medicines, quantities, availability, commercial terms and bank-wire payment terms.
Quotation.fieldInvalid: Please check your notes or selected reason.
Quotation.documentHelp: Only the current authorized quotation and its server totals apply. Questions, payment arrangements and revisions are handled directly with MedAxis. Secure updated links are delivered by email; WeChat and WhatsApp are for direct conversation.

errorTitle.superseded: A newer quotation version is available
errorTitle.unavailable: The quotation service is temporarily unavailable
errorTitle.unknown: We could not confirm this quotation

errorHelp.expired: The expired commercial document is not available through this link. Request an updated quotation below or contact our team.
errorHelp.superseded: Use the latest link sent to you by MedAxis or contact our team. This link cannot show or accept the superseded version.
errorHelp.missing: This link is invalid or unavailable. Check the original email or contact our official team.
errorHelp.validation: Check the marked fields and try again. No login, OTP or SMS code is needed.
errorHelp.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait, then check the current status before taking another action.
errorHelp.unavailable: Please check the current status again or contact our team. An interrupted action may already have been received.
errorHelp.unknown: We could not confirm the result. Check the current status or contact our team.

notice.accepted: Your acceptance is confirmed. Use the server reservation deadline and bank instructions in this document.
notice.alreadyAccepted: This quotation is already accepted. Its existing reservation deadline is unchanged.
notice.revisionSent: Your revision request was received. Discuss changes with our team and use the new quotation link when issued.
notice.refreshSent: Your updated-quotation request was received. Our team will provide the new link through your contact channel; check your email.
notice.declined: This quotation is declined. Contact our team if you would like to discuss your requirements.
notice.acceptUncertain: We could not confirm your acceptance. Check the current status or retry the same acceptance; do not make a different decision until this is resolved.
notice.decisionUncertain: Your request may already have been received. It will not be submitted again automatically. Check status or contact our team before sending another revision or refresh request.

Utility.privacyBody: This website stores your selected language in the medaxis_locale cookie for up to one year. Your RFQ list is stored locally in your browser. You can remove it using Clear list or your browser storage settings. Opening WhatsApp or another contact channel takes you to that provider's service.
Utility.analyticsBody: When enabled, Plausible provides aggregate website analytics on public pages. Private quotation and administration routes are excluded.
Utility.termsBody: This website supports pharmaceutical sourcing enquiries. Adding an item to your RFQ list does not confirm stock, a purchase, a prescription or an order. Availability, documentation, commercial terms and shipment arrangements require confirmation from MedAxis.
